name: Eliminationism
notAnIdeology: An analytical category coined by Daniel Goldhagen for a family of aims toward a target group (transformation, repression, expulsion, prevention of reproduction, extermination), applied by scholars and critics to actors of differing ideologies; no adherents hold a shared programme under this name, and its reviewers (Shaw, Glazer) treat it as a concept to be tested, not a set of political beliefs.

sources.title: Martin Shaw, Review of Goldhagen, Worse Than War, International Affairs (2010)
Nathan Glazer, Eliminationism Negated, The American Interest (2010)
